notes: The search engine returned almost nothing indexed under WWU unit domains, so findings rest mainly on direct page fetches of the unit sites. The Faculty-Staff resources site (login required) and TA/grader resources linked from cs.wwu.edu were not reachable and could hold unit guidance. Press coverage says WWU has no university-wide AI policy and leaves decisions to instructors, with a default that unauthorized generative AI use is academic dishonesty (already collected at the university layer). No separate Data Science unit page was found or checked.
